intro: Tests verb+ing with like, love, hate, enjoy, don't mind, don't like vs. present simple

items.why: Third-person singular present simple; subject is she.

items.q: I love ___ to music before bed.
He doesn't mind ___ the dishes after dinner.
They ___ walking to school every day.
items.why: Subject is they; base form enjoy, then verb+ing follows.

items.q: I hate ___ up early on weekends.

parts.title: Complete the sentences with the correct form.

items.why: Third-person singular present simple; no verb+ing needed.

items.post: for the bus in the morning.
swimming in the sea in summer.
items.why: Subject is we; use base form love, then verb+ing follows.

parts.title: Find and correct the mistake in each sentence.

items.sentence: I enjoy to drink tea in the morning.
items.corrected: I enjoy drinking tea in the morning.
items.why: After enjoy, use verb+ing, not to+infinitive.

items.sentence: She love watching films at the weekend.
items.corrected: She loves watching films at the weekend.
items.why: Third-person singular present simple needs -s on love.

items.sentence: I don't mind to help you with the shopping.
items.corrected: I don't mind helping you with the shopping.
items.why: After don't mind, use verb+ing, not to+infinitive.

parts.title: Write your own sentences.
parts.pointsLabel: 2 points: 1 for correct form, 1 for meaning and use

items.prompt: Write one sentence about an activity you like doing in your free time.
items.criteria: Accept any sentence using I like/love/enjoy + verb+ing with correct spelling.
items.example: I like playing video games in the evening.

items.prompt: Write one sentence about something you hate or don't like doing at home.
items.criteria: Accept any sentence using I hate/don't like + verb+ing with correct spelling.
items.example: I hate cleaning the bathroom every week.
